component.name: KRsync
component.summary: Keep folders in sync with rsync

description.p: KRsync is a friendly front end for rsync, built for Plasma. Save each pair of folders as a session and synchronize it with one click, locally or over SSH.

ul.li: Sessions with every common rsync option, explained in plain language
Simulate a run first to see exactly what would change
Live progress, speed and time remaining, also shown in the task manager
Searchable log with separate views for changes and errors
Imports and exports Grsync session files
